title: Bonsai 27B received linked public project, demo, and model-collection entry points
summary: On 2026-07-16, Bonsai 27B was associated with a PrismML news page, a GitHub demo repository, and a Hugging Face collection. Together, these dated links indicate a public development milestone connecting project information, demonstration code, and model resources. No technical capabilities, version, or release status are asserted because the underlying materials have not been researched.
